It is a manufacturer of [[surfactants]] and [[speciality chemicals]] for cleaning and personal care space, and its more than 200 products are exported to over 100 countries. Galaxy has over 1400 clients including [[Colgate-Palmolive]], [[Dabur]], [[Himalaya]], [[L'Oréal]] and [[Unilever]] and more. Performance surfactants account for 60% of revenue, and specialty personal care products account for the rest.{{cite news |last1=Tewari |first1=Maulik |title=Why you should accumulate the stock of Galaxy Surfactants |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/portfolio/stock-fundamental-analysis-india/why-you-should-accumulate-the-stock-of-galaxy-surfactants/article34345589.ece |access-date=26 February 2022 |work=[[Business Line]] |date=April 17, 2021 |language=en}} Galaxy is considered a power player in the global surfactants market.{{cite news |last1=Jauhari |first1=Ujjval |title=Galaxy Surfactants in focus as supply challenges hit specialty chemical makers |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/mark-to-market/galaxy-surfactants-in-focus-as-supply-challenges-hit-specialty-chemical-makers-11637214883970.html |access-date=26 February 2022 |work=[[Mint (newspaper)|mint]] |date=18 November 2021 |language=en}} In 2020, the annual turnover was {{INR}}2,563 [[crore]]. According to Unnathan Shekhar, managing director of Galaxy Surfactants, two-thirds of their business comes from international customers.{{cite news |title=Galaxy Surfactants will have a Capex outlay of Rs 150-200 crore every year: U Shekhar, MD |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-galaxy-surfactants-will-have-a-capex-outlay-of-rs-150-200-crore-every-year-u-shekhar-md-170704 |access-date=26 February 2022 |work=[[Zee Business]] |date=15 November 2021}} In 2020, the company spent nearly {{INR}}60 crore and filed for 62 patents.{{cite news |last1=Prashant |first1=Pravin |title=Galaxy Surfactants bags 62 patents |url=https://www.indianchemicalnews.com/chemical/galaxy-surfactants-bags-62-patents-5986 |access-date=26 February 2022 |work=Indian Chemical News |date=August 25, 2020}} ==History== The company was founded in 1980 by Unnathan Shekhar, Geera Ramakrishnan, Shashi Shanbhag, CR Ramakrishna, and Sudhir Patil, five friends, all aged 23, who all came from different backgrounds.{{cite news |last1=Mishra |first1=Lalatendu |title=Mumbai-based Galaxy Surfactants makes difference in green process innovation |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/mumbai/city-based-galaxy-surfactants-makes-difference-in-green-process-innovation/article25861923.ece |access-date=26 February 2022 |work=[[The Hindu]] |date=29 December 2018 |language=en-IN}} They began their company as contract manufacturers for [[Colgate-Palmolive]], producing [[Sodium laureth sulfate]] in a small lab in [[Ghatkopar]]. In 1984, Galaxy opened its first plant at [[Tarapur, Maharashtra|Tarapur]] and its second plant for [[sulfonation]] was opened in [[Taloja]] in 1998. Galaxy also started a research centre at [[Navi Mumbai]] in 1997. In July 2009, Galaxy acquired ''TRI‐K Industries'', a distributor and producer of specialty ingredients.{{cite news |title=Galaxy Surfactants acquires majority stakes in TRI-K and OTC Galaxy Surfactants Ltd. is an Indian multinational specialty chemical company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It is a manufacturer of surfactants and speciality chemicals for cleaning and personal care space, and its more than 200 products are exported to over 100 countries. Galaxy has over 1400 clients including  Colgate-Palmolive, Dabur, Himalaya, L'Oréal and Unilever and more. Performance surfactants account for 60% of revenue, and specialty personal care products account for the rest.
Galaxy is considered a power player in the global surfactants market. In 2020, the annual turnover was ₹2,563 crore. According to Unnathan Shekhar, managing director of Galaxy Surfactants, two-thirds of their business comes from international customers. In 2020, the company spent nearly ₹60 crore and filed for 62 patents.
